description: Save a new version of a page: a new title, a new body, or both, with an optional change note. `ifVersion` is the version you read with anyforge_get_page; if someone saved since, this is refused with 409 and you should read the page again. This replaces the text directly, everyone sees it at once: to propose a change for an editor to accept instead, use anyforge_propose_page_edit. Only call when the person asked for this change.

content.description: The whole new body, in markdown.

name: anyforge_update_page
title: Update page
